explicit_gates: Never plot a mission coordinate as a confirmed Holovator location
Keep GG X/Y values in its own coordinate space
Sector labels may refer to mission approach and road boundary, not necessarily Holovator entrance
No exact altitude/floor inferred from 2D map
No external image copied, only links
The 23 source Holovator category markers must each be inspected separately before 23 Atlas pins are claimed
